objective: Add an accurate, explanatory visual to every slide from slide 4 onward in the user-provided SAIL PowerPoint, preserve the source deck, render and verify the edited deck, and return a downloadable copy.

tasks.title: Inspect every source slide, template hierarchy, text, notes, and layout
Develop an accurate slide-by-slide visual brief for slides 4 through the end
Generate or source one distinct explanatory visual for every slide from slide 4 onward
Insert and crop visuals while preserving the existing PowerPoint style and editable hierarchy
Add asset source notes to speaker notes where required
Render every slide, inspect individually, fix overlaps, clipping, wrapping, and poor crops
Run presentation overflow tests and deliver the preserved-source output copy
Commit and push only the session record and workspace outputs without disturbing unrelated changes
